_note: Cross-Resonance. Carrying Symbols from rival Patrons generates friction. edge_loci are places where one side starts a step better in Position; friction lines are prompts for SB spends. Relationships are symmetric — look a patron up on either side.

rulings.name: Position Nudge
rulings.text: In a home locus, start one step better; in a rival's locus, one step worse.

rulings.name: Effect Shade
rulings.text: Where a Patron dominates, consider an Effect bump; where opposed, consider Limited Effect unless it is paid for.

rulings.name: Symbol Interference
rulings.text: Carrying both sides' Symbols raises the noise: the first rite each scene may mark +1 Obligation, at the GM's call.

rulings.name: SB Colour
rulings.text: When spending SB in these matchups, prefer the suit that fits — Hearts for social, Spades for harm and escalation, Clubs for material cost, Diamonds for numinous disturbance.

pairs.edge_loci: Crossroads, abandoned gates, wind-scoured battlefields.
pairs.friction: vows dissolve in the storm; liberty shatters oaths; the dawn sears absence into memory.
